title: TCM-5CEVAL: EXTENDED DEEP EVALUATION BENCHMARK FOR LLM’S COMPREHENSIVE CLINICAL RESEARCH COMPETENCE IN TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating medical and clinical reasoning within the domain of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). While TCM is rooted in Chinese culture and utilizes classical texts, the benchmark is designed to measure medical knowledge, clinical decision-making, and pharmacological proficiency rather than religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
